teaser: At two in the morning, the glow of a phone screen catches you still awake, chasing a thought that will not resolve. You are a life path 11, carrying a charge not entirely your own, paired with an ENFP's reach toward whatever might still be possible. The 11 asks you to act as a kind of beacon, carrying a current you did not choose. The ENFP arrives already alight, curious about every open door. Crossed together, the charge rarely runs short of outlets, and the task on a given night is less about generating the spark than choosing which wire to follow.
